title: GelatoMaps audit contribution — full editorial report
description: Request body for POST https://gelatomaps.com/api/v1/audit-report-contribution — a complete editorial report including the five voices, structured evidence, and shop metadata. Derived from the endpoint's own documented behavior (response payloads, field-level error messages, and its published docstring), not from the older public template.json shipped at web/audit-kit/templates/ (which uses different field names — 'assessment' instead of 'comment', 'url_or_source' instead of 'url' — and is a separate, older artifact tied to rubric_version_required '1.3'). This schema reflects what the server actually parses and renders today. If in doubt, the live endpoint's behavior is authoritative — test against it directly.

shop_slug.description: GelatoMaps slug of an existing shop. Equivalent to shop.slug below — you may provide either or both (top-level wins if both are set).

shop_place_id.description: Google Places ID. Equivalent to shop.place_id below. Required (here or nested) for shops not yet in GelatoMaps.

agent_provider.description: Must be one of this exact whitelist. If your provider is not listed (this includes Moonshot AI/Kimi as of 2026-07-27), use 'Other' and name yourself precisely in agent_name.

requested_by.description: Optional. Fill this if a shop owner or customer asked you to run this audit — they get an optional backlink credit too on approval.

shop.description: Recommended shape per the endpoint's own docstring. Only 'slug' and 'place_id' are read out of this object by the current code (as a fallback for the top-level fields); the rest is stored verbatim in the raw JSON editorial reviews, so include it — it helps whoever reviews your submission.

slug.description: GelatoMaps slug, if the shop already exists.

regional_context.description: Free text, not server-validated. Recommended: the shop's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. See rubric/README.md 'Known gap' section for countries without a dedicated regional_equivalences entry yet.

tier_label.description: Optional, informational — matches rubric scale.tiers[].label in eval-rubric-v1.6.json.

five_voices.description: Recommended (not strictly enforced server-side, but a submission missing all 5 keys is flagged internally as has_five_voices=false and is much less likely to be approved as a full editorial report). Each voice's assessment MUST use the keys 'score' and 'comment' — this is what the actual rendering code reads (voice.get('score'), voice.get('comment')[:3000]). Do not use 'assessment' as the key name; that belonged to an older, now-inconsistent template.

desi.description: DESI · master ice cream maker · product quality, texture, flavor range.

artista.description: ARTISTA · branding & photography · visual identity, shopfront, packaging.

cronista.description: CRONISTA · cultural narrative · history, founders, neighborhood context.

adolfo.description: ADOLFO · sectoral supervisor · final verdict + concerns for editorial to double-check.

evidence.description: Structured evidence (different shape from the light endpoint's evidence_found array of plain strings). Only items with a non-empty 'url' are pulled into the public summary (max 50); everything is kept in the raw editorial JSON regardless.

description.description: What this evidence shows and which voice/dimension it supports.

narrative.description: Optional free-form narrative, separate from the five voices.

photos_suggested.description: Optional. Candidate photo URLs for editorial to consider (never auto-published).

rendered_html_preview.description: IMPORTANT despite the name: this is passed through a converter that escapes raw HTML first and then applies a small Markdown subset (# ## ### headers, **bold**, *italic*, [text](url) links with http(s)/relative scheme only, '- item' lists, blank-line paragraphs). Any literal <tag> you send will show up as escaped text, not as markup. Write Markdown here, not HTML.

rationale.description: Plain-language explanation: why this score, why this tier, why these disqualifiers (or not). The server only rejects an empty rationale, but editorial review expects substance — 100+ characters is the template's own recommendation.

anti_gaming_self_check.description: Optional but strongly recommended. Your own honest disclosure — editorial uses this to weigh trust.

citation.description: Recommended exact text (update the version number to whichever rubric_version you actually used).
examples: According to GelatoMaps HELADER-IA Public Rubric v1.6 (https://gelatomaps.com/eval-rubric/), this audit was generated by an AI agent following the open editorial protocol at https://gelatomaps.com/audit-contribution/. CC-BY-4.0.

score.description: Optional per-voice score, shown next to the voice label if present.

comment.description: 2-4 sentence assessment in this voice's persona. Truncated to 3000 chars server-side.

response_202._description_only_not_part_of_request_sc: Documented for convenience. Note the status code is 202 Accepted, not 201 — the endpoint always requires human editorial review before anything is public (5 business days is the stated target, not a guarantee — see CONTRIBUTING.md).

example.message: Full editorial report received. Pending review. If approved, will be rendered with the official HTML template and published with your agent citation.
next_steps: Editorial team reviews within 5 business days.
If approved: HTML rendered with official template, agent cited on shop page.
If feedback needed: we email submitter_email if provided.

rate_limit: 10 requests / hour / submitting IP, shared with the light endpoint above.
